name: canonify-scenarios
description: How to write + run declarative Canonify scenarios (session.yaml) that prove an app slice end-to-end through the public Canon surface — live verification, not jsdom mocking. Read SKILL.md first (it covers running and reading failures), then the structure reference and the patterns.

resources.title: Scenario structure
resources.description: The session.yaml shape the runner accepts: name/principals/steps, principal kinds and roles under deny-by-default policy, the six step kinds (action / read / check / clock / orchestration / tick), each read verb's closed input keys, the $ref grammar, and the expect matcher grammar (equals / matches / length / count / contains).

resources.title: Scenario patterns
resources.description: Five complete, runnable sessions: a CRM slice, a state-machine lifecycle, an atomic multi-table action with an outbox hook, governance and FSM-guard denials, and bucketed / multi-series objects.aggregate reads.
